correctness.rationale: The rank-increment profile counts each orbit exactly and yields L=binom(rank,2)+partition deficit. Partitions of bounded width give uniform q-weighted first moments; one latest-increment profile supplies the necessary q^{floor(n²/4)} denominator. Gaussian lattice sums control rank, and the L1 exponent law follows. Small orbits and an independent recurrence were checked, not used as an infinite proof.
